title: Grateful Dead Live at Radio City Music Hall on 1980-10-29
lineage: Cassette (Sony TC-WE475) -> Sony R500 (Pass Through) -> SEK'D Prodif Plus -> Samplitude Professional v8.01 -> FLAC

ai_review.summary: Soundboard partial with a noticeable left‑channel imbalance, but a fast and enjoyable performance.
ai_review.review: The recording is sourced from the soundboard, though listeners note a blown‑speaker/mic issue that leaves the left channel weaker than the right. Musically the show is praised for its energy, albeit a bit faster than expected, making it an engaging listen despite the technical hiccup.

ai_rating.rationale: Only two brief reviews; one praises the show (3★) while the other points out a channel imbalance (4★). Weighted average of show (≈3.5) and recording quality (≈3) yields a modest rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Left‑channel mic/speaker appears blown or weak, causing imbalance; otherwise typical soundboard clarity.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Performance described as fast‑paced; no specific set‑structure comments.
